notablePrerequisites:
Synod Artificer does not have summoning sickness.
Orochi Hatchery has at least four charge counters on it.
description:
Activate Orochi Hatchery by paying {5} and tapping it, creating at least four 1/1 Snake creature tokens.
Each Snake enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm that many times, untapping all creatures.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing three Snakes, adding six {C}.
Activate Synod Artificer's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Orochi Hatchery.
Repeat.
